summary.text: Night Wolf grotto-heaven is a human grotto-heaven in the two heavens led by Night Heavenly Wolf Lord, with Ye Zhi among its Gu Immortals.

claims.text: At Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch’s black-heaven discussion of uniting against the five regions, Night Heavenly Wolf Lord speaks for Night Wolf grotto-heaven and says it does not want to expose itself, citing an immense enmity with Northern Plains’ Longevity Heaven.

Night Heavenly Wolf Lord returns to Night Wolf grotto-heaven and is greeted by many Gu Immortals there. Ye Zhi talks over the pressure of the five regions and the choice between variant humans and humanity. Night Heavenly Wolf Lord agrees with Lady Cold Ash that their human grotto-heavens will advance and retreat together, and he favors secretly contacting Central Continent’s Heavenly Court. Narration calls him an experienced rank eight leader whom nobody in Night Wolf grotto-heaven defies. Qin Ding Ling receives his approach and notes that Night Wolf grotto-heaven has grudges with Longevity Heaven; she knows very little about him and the grotto-heaven, yet keeps contact while Zhou Xiong Xin investigates the two heavens.

Night Heavenly Wolf Lord judges that when the five regions counterattack, Night Wolf grotto-heaven will face calamity with the rest of the two heavens alliance. From the start he means to defect to the five regions for his own sake and for the future of the entire Night Wolf grotto-heaven, and he replies that he will cooperate with Heavenly Court as their spy.
After joining Heavenly Court in secret, he returns to Night Wolf grotto-heaven, mobilizes forces, and informs Heavenly Court of new developments.

When Dragon Palace takes him down and the betrayal is proven, the immortals want Night Wolf grotto-heaven to pay the price; Wu Shuai says Night Heavenly Wolf Lord must be punished but that the urgent matter is the bigger picture.

Fang Yuan orders an invasion of Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven and Night Wolf grotto-heaven. Narration states that Night Wolf grotto-heaven’s previous owner, Night Heavenly Wolf Lord, had surrendered to Heavenly Court, that Wu Shuai had killed him in Dragon Palace, and that Fang Yuan now moves to take revenge and annex them. Before battle begins, Night Wolf grotto-heaven opens its entrance. Ye Zhi leads the grotto-heaven Gu Immortals out to bow and ask Fang Yuan to accept their surrender. Fang Yuan takes them in without a slaughter.
